title: John 6:48 and John 4:14 — bread of life and the well of water springing up
summary: John 6:48 ("I am the bread of life") above a second quotation labelled John 6:48 in English but Ἰωάνης 4:14 in Greek: whoever drinks the water Jesus gives will never thirst, and it becomes a well of water springing up to eternal life. Bread is brown, water is light blue, and the Hebrew ישוע (Yeshua) in red signs the second quote.

text.text: 14 but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him shall never thirst; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”—

uncertain: The second header reads John 6:48 in English but Ἰωάνης 4:14 in Greek; the quoted text is John 4:14 (transcribed as shown).
